`sleep`: wait for a time.

## Synopsis

<strong>sleep</strong> <em>seconds</em>

## Description

<strong>sleep</strong> waits <em>seconds</em> seconds, then exits. The number may have a fraction (<strong>sleep 0.5</strong>).

## Exit status

0 after the wait; 1, with a usage message, when <em>seconds</em> is missing or isn't a number.

## Notes

Only one argument is read; there are no unit suffixes (<strong>s</strong>, <strong>m</strong>, <strong>h</strong>).

## See also

<strong>sh</strong>(1), <strong>time</strong>(1)
